Websites like this do not run off of one big blob of code. Everything is split up into services, controllers, etc. If one of the services (like the MembershipService used for handling logins) fails to initialize when the application (website) starts up, it can result in the entire application crashing. The server will most likely try to restart the app-pool, but if the bug (or bad data) remains, the app will simply crash again - over and over - until someone fixes the underlying issue.
